mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rate_bucket(scope,key_hmac,window_start,counter,reserved_chars,expires_at) VALUES('send-serial',#{key},'1970-01-01 00:00:00.000',0,0,#{expiry}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE expires_at=#{expiry}
INSERT INTO rate_bucket(scope,key_hmac,window_start,counter,reserved_chars,expires_at) VALUES(#{scope},#{key},#{window},1,0,#{expiry}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE counter=counter+1
mapper.select: SELECT counter FROM rate_bucket WHERE scope=#{scope} AND key_hmac=#{key} AND window_start=#{window} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE rate_bucket SET counter=GREATEST(0,counter-1) WHERE scope=#{scope} AND key_hmac=#{key} AND window_start=#{window}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM rate_bucket WHERE expires_at < #{now} LIMIT 200
